# ---------------------------------------------------------------- B-10, held
#
# Step 03's three Java 7 constructs. The DEPARTURE denominators are step 03's
# own populations and never move: 93 explicit type arguments removed, 11
# hand-written close() calls removed, 11 java.nio.file sites arrived. The
# ARRIVAL denominators are how much of that work a tree at THIS rung must still
# be holding, and two of the three move here.
#
#   target.diamond        71   93 diamonds arrived at step 03. 19 went at step 05
#                              with the sink constructions of the accumulate
#                              buckets; the 20th went at step 07, because
#                              MethodParameterInjectionPoint#getAnnotations had
#                              to become Set.of(...) and a factory has no
#                              type-argument position. The 21st and 22nd go
#                              HERE: DynamicServiceLoader:196 and spi
#                              ServiceLoader:142 are both new LinkedHashSet<>(),
#                              the accumulators the two hand-written loaders
#                              filled a line at a time, and C-3 replaces both
#                              loops with a stream collecting to
#                              LinkedHashSet::new. A method reference has no
#                              type-argument position either.
#   target.try.resources  7    9 resource clauses arrived at step 03. C-3
#                              deletes two of them, one per loader, both
#                              `try (InputStream is = url.openStream(); ...)`
#                              reading a provider file a line at a time --
#                              reading java.util.ServiceLoader now does itself.
#   target.iofile         4    measured on this tree, not asserted: step 03
#                              left two java.io.File sites behind and a hold
#                              gate holds what it was handed.

# -------------------------------------------------------------- family C
#
# C-1 and C-2: the module graph. 12 published jars, each of which must declare
# an Automatic-Module-Name, and the names are in modnames.txt.
#
#   target.mod.derivable   11   and not 12, which is a requirement of this tree
#                               rather than a defect a candidate could fix.
#                               ModuleFinder can DERIVE a descriptor for a jar
#                               only if every non-comment line of every
#                               META-INF/services file in it is a binary class
#                               name in that jar. arquillian-impl-base ships
#                               META-INF/services/org.jboss.arquillian.impl.
#                               configuration.api.ArquillianDescriptor whose
#                               lines are implClass= / importerClass= /
#                               defaultName= properties, because that is what
#                               org.jboss.shrinkwrap.descriptor.api.Descriptors
#                               reads back -- as a java.util.Properties -- in the
#                               PINNED 0.1.4. Deleting the file was built and
#                               measured: 152 of the 935 recorded behaviours
#                               change, 88 of them because the frozen probe
#                               itself calls Descriptors.importAs. So 11 is what
#                               a fully migrated tree reads, it is also what the
#                               UNMIGRATED tree reads, and C-1 folds it in as a
#                               min() term: it raises no floor and can only be
#                               lost.
target.mod.total=12
target.mod.derivable=11

# C-3: service lookup. 2 methods must stop scanning META-INF/services by
# hand and must call java.util.ServiceLoader.load; 11 must go on loading one
# class by name. All three sets are svc.txt, and the file names every bucket.
target.svc.legacy=2
target.svc.arrive=2
target.svc.keep=11
